notes.method: Edge 1 measured on B09 (2021, near-frontal, slight keystone): main block 13.4 m + south annex 3.4 m of the 16.8 m OSM edge; 51.4 px/m at ground-floor level, 49.1 px/m at upper-floor level, each row normalised to the block width. Cross-checked against 145 (oblique from the SW).
notes.heights: String course 5.35, upper windows 5.67-7.32, cornice ~7.95-8.25, parapet piers to ~9.0 above the pavement: lower than the ~9 m cornice estimate in the notes; the gate is ~2.2 x 3.5 m and the annex opening ~1.4 x 2.2 m (sill ~1.1 m), smaller than the notes' estimates.
notes.compromises: One width per floor, so all 9 upper windows are 0.68 m (real 0.55-0.85, the centre of each group wider). Ground windows start at the fixed 1.6 m (real sill ~1.25). Upper floor base 4.95 so the windows land within 0.2 m; the generated string course is therefore ~0.4 m low. Parapet left solid: the real one is 6 stone piers with black steel railings between them; the 'balustrade' option was tried but its coping boxes overlap coplanar at every ring corner (audit, ~1 m2 on this building). Corner box lamps are wall_lantern stand-ins. The gate's black lattice is shown as a dark void. The annex shares the building height (in reality 1 storey, ~5.3 m). Edge 0 (north, faces the SCSC across a 3-4 m passage) is plain per notes B4.
notes.edge2: Edge 2 (south face of the annex, 145, low-med confidence on positions): a rectangular cream roll-down near the SW corner and a round-arched cream roll-down next to it; the rest of the 12.4 m face is hidden in the photos and left plain at ground level.
notes.edges: Edge keys follow the scene_spec ring as of 2026-10-19 evening (ring start rotated by the city-wide make_spec changes): 7 = west main facade (u from the north end), 6 = north face on the passage to the SCSC, 0 = south face of the annex (u from the west end). Before the rotation these were 1, 0 and 2.
